source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: ("residential segregation" OR "spatial segregation") AND (class OR caste OR religion OR Muslim)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:("residential segregation" OR "spatial segregation") AND (class OR caste OR religion OR Muslim),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has (("Muslim" OR "caste" OR "class" OR "religion") AND ("residential segregation" OR "spatial segregation"))
